about: Corrections to the person layer of the club ledger (data/index/athletes.jsonl, ESPN's core athlete records), applied by the entity build (pipeline/encode-ledger.mjs, pipeline/lib/ledger/athlete-corrections.mjs) before the DOB plausibility rule. Kind `dob`: set a player's birth date, and nationality/position where right_value gives them (a null removes ESPN's value). Applied only when every receipt verifies: a Wikidata receipt against data/index/wikidata/players.json (item, field, value), an RSSSF receipt against the cap row's line_quote in data/index/rsssf-caps.jsonl. Sources are never edited. Docs: pipeline/docs/compact.md (The person layer).

corrections.reason: ESPN's core athlete record for 12912 describes a younger namesake: a Mexican Luis Martínez born 1987-04-29. The ledger rows under that id are Barcelona's Luis Enrique, 2002-03 and 2003-04, which the 1987 date would make La Liga's youngest scorer at 15y 125d (ahead of Yamal). Wikidata Q222789 (Luis Enrique, Spain) gives 1970-05-08, and his RSSSF log carries 62 Spain caps from 1991-04-17 to 2002-06-22: a player born in 1987 can't have won a senior cap in 1991. Position set to null because ESPN's belongs to the namesake's record.

receipts.source: Wikidata Q222789 'Luis Enrique' (citizenship Spain), P569 date of birth, from the CC0 players harvest
